basic_profile.bio: Based in the UK, I'm a culinary enthusiast and aspiring chef who loves exploring diverse cuisines, especially comfort foods. When not whipping up new recipes, I enjoy trucking simulations and diving into virtual adventures. I often find myself browsing Reddit during late evenings, after a day of work as a sous-chef in a bustling London restaurant. Currently single, I value my independence and cherish my downtime spent gaming and learning about mental health to better support friends and family.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in culinary arts and a passion for self-learning, which has led me to explore various online resources and communities. My expertise in cooking is complemented by a growing interest in mental health, guided by personal experiences and online courses.
